mobileHome.newVideoSub: Name your project and start editing
mobileHome.makeShortSub: Pick clips and photos. We cut, caption and frame them for you.
mobileHome.chooseMediaSub: Pick as many as you want

planner.title: Planner
planner.subtitle: Every scheduled and published post, across all your projects.
planner.loadError: The planner could not load. Try again in a moment.
planner.outOfRange: Pick a time between one minute and six and a half days from now.
planner.markError: Could not mark this post as posted.
planner.dragHint: Drag a scheduled post onto another day to move it.
planner.empty: Nothing planned this month. Schedule a post from the Shorts panel of a project.
planner.manualNote: Automatic publishing didn't go through. Post it yourself from the app, then mark it as posted.
planner.metricsPending: Stats appear a day or two after publishing.
planner.exportsError: Your exports could not load. Try again in a moment.
planner.noCloud: Exports are not stored in the cloud on this server, so they cannot be posted from here.
planner.noExports: No exports yet. Export a video from a project first, then come back to post it.

analytics.empty: Publish a video through Vibed to start collecting performance data.
analytics.periodNote: Gained in the last {{count}} days, across {{posts}} post(s) with stats.
analytics.approximateNote: Some posts only have stats from inside this period, so their share is a minimum.
analytics.noDailyData: No views recorded in this period yet. Platforms report with a delay of one to two days.
analytics.lagNote: Stats are collected once a day. YouTube reports two days behind; Instagram can take up to 48 hours.
analytics.engagementHint: Likes, comments, shares and saves per 100 views
analytics.rankEmpty: Needs posts at least 3 days old with stats.
analytics.weakestEmpty: Shown once 4 posts at least 3 days old have stats.
analytics.needThree: Needs 3 posts with stats ({{count}} so far).
analytics.suggestionsHint: Accepted suggestions are applied to the next shorts you finish.
